name: DiskInfo
author: Hermes Agent
description: Free space on the server that hosts the bot: every real filesystem as an embed with a bar, used/free/total size and mountpoint, plus an optional PNG bar card. Pseudo filesystems, bind mounts, loop devices and tiny partitions are filtered out per guild.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no user data. Per guild it keeps the list of hidden mountpoints and two display settings (size cut-off, chart on/off) in Red's Config.
install_msg: Thanks for installing DiskInfo! `[p]df` shows the disk usage of the host, `[p]df chart` attaches the PNG card. The picture needs Pillow (`[p]pipinstall pillow`) and the **Attach Files** permission; the embed works without both.
short: Disk usage of the bot's host, as an embed with an optional chart
